desc:
Run through the obby and collect rare NPCs!

👋 Welcome to "Asahi Smile Party Simulator"! Have fun with Asahi Soft Drinks!

How to Play:
🏃 Run through the obby!
🥤 Buy water from vending machines
🙌 Talk to random NPCs
   (Give them water to make friends!)
🤝 Bring NPCs back to base
💎 NPCs generate "wakuwaku"
   (Buy drinks with "wakuwaku")
💪 Buy drinks to boost your skills
🔄 Rebirth for base upgrades!

👥 Play with friends to get more "wakuwaku"
👍️ Like the game & join the group for rare NPCs! 🎁

* Note: Drink skill-ups (such as increased speed and jump height) refer solely to in-game player progression and do not imply any real-world health or physical benefits.
